items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: I bought a band jewel in 1920 from Grunewald Music Store. Yeah. Not Grunewald. Where are lines? C.G. Conn.

ctx.x: Well, after I put the violin down, I came right after the war. I was here in 1919. I've been here ever since. You moved here right after the war. Right after the war. When I got demobilized out of the army, I came here and lived here. I've been here ever since. All right. I bought a band jewel in 1920 from Grunewald Music Store. Yeah. Not Grunewald. Where are lines? C.G. Conn.
Oh, Conn. Yeah. They had a story.
I bought a tenor van jewel. It cost $150 there. And learned that the first band that I started playing with when I bought the van jewel, it was Jack Carrey's band.
